title: Pretty tray with glued on image and legs that might crack
text: Pretty tray with glued on image and legs that might crack. This is not exactly as I expected. It is a wooden tray in a beautiful aqua color. However, the image is a decal that is just pasted on the top. I guess I just thought it would be stamped on in paint and then shellacked over but that is not the case. Also, the legs open up but I hear them cracking as I open and close them. I can see them establishing a crack in the wood over time. However, this tray can be used without the legs. It is pretty from a distance, but up close I am not as pleased. However, for the current price of $26.99, one gets what they pay for. I like this but not enough to recommend it or buy another one.
